# Zenlio - AI Automation & Custom Web Systems

Outcome-focused automation and high-performance web systems for small teams ready to scale without expanding headcount.

## Core Capabilities
- **AI Automation & Workflows**: n8n custom integrations, automated lead routing, and customer support agent databases.
- **Custom Web Systems**: High-performance Next.js architectures, modern web designs, and database integrations.
- **CRM Integrations**: Automatic form-to-CRM syncing, client onboarding sequence pipelines, and pipeline dashboard tracking.
